item.title: UW-Oshkosh to reinstate men's soccer program in fall 2027
item.description: OSHKOSH, Wis. (WFRV) – The University of Wisconsin–Oshkosh announced Monday that men’s soccer will return as a varsity sport beginning in the fall of 2027. Chancellor Manohar Singh and Assistant Chancellor for Intercollegiate Athletics Darryl Sims said the addition will make men’s soccer the university’s 22nd varsity sport.
